<script>
(function () {
  // Use ?staff=1 to mark internal, ?staff=0 to clear
  var m = location.search.match(/[?&]staff=(0|1)(?:&|$)/);
  if (!m) return;
  var v = m[1];

  var parts = [
    'stork_internal=' + v,
    'path=/',
    // set for all subdomains; change to your base domain if needed
    'domain=.storkaup.is',
    'SameSite=Lax'
  ];
  if (location.protocol === 'https:') parts.push('Secure');
  parts.push('max-age=' + (v === '1' ? 31536000 : 0)); // 1 year or clear

  document.cookie = parts.join(';');
})();
</script>

<script>
(function() {
  if (window.location.pathname.indexOf('/vara/') === -1) return;

  // --- helpers ---
  function upsertMeta(name, content) {
    if (!content) return;
    var existing = document.querySelector('meta[name="' + name + '"]');
    if (existing) {
      existing.setAttribute('content', content);
    } else {
      var meta = document.createElement('meta');
      meta.name = name;
      meta.content = content;
      document.head.appendChild(meta);
    }
  }

  function truncate(text, max) {
    if (!text) return '';
    if (text.length <= max) return text;
    var truncated = text.substring(0, max);
    var lastSpace = truncated.lastIndexOf(' ');
    if (lastSpace > 0) truncated = truncated.substring(0, lastSpace);
    return truncated + '…';
  }

  // --- extract schema.org Product data ---
  function getProductSchema() {
    var scripts = document.querySelectorAll('script[type="application/ld+json"]');
    for (var i = 0; i < scripts.length; i++) {
      try {
        var json = JSON.parse(scripts[i].textContent.trim());
        if (json['@type'] === 'Product') return json;
        if (json['@graph']) {
          for (var j = 0; j < json['@graph'].length; j++) {
            if (json['@graph'][j]['@type'] === 'Product') return json['@graph'][j];
          }
        }
      } catch(e) {}
    }
    return null;
  }

  function buildMeta() {
    var schema = getProductSchema();

    // main description (prefer HTML, fallback to schema)
    var descEl = document.querySelector('div.overflow-hidden.transition-all.duration-300');
    var desc = descEl && descEl.textContent ? descEl.textContent.trim() : '';
    if (!desc && schema && schema.description) desc = schema.description;
    if (!desc || desc.length < 10) {
      var titleEl = document.querySelector('h1');
      var title = titleEl ? titleEl.textContent.trim() : '';
      desc = title ? 'Kauptu ' + title + ' hjá Stórkaup – fagvörur fyrir fyrirtæki og stofnanir.' : '';
    }

    // brand + SKU
    var brand = schema && schema.brand && schema.brand.name ? schema.brand.name.trim() : '';
    var sku = schema && schema.sku ? schema.sku.trim() : '';

    // combine
    var combined = '';
    if (sku) combined += sku + ' | ';
    if (brand) combined += brand + ' | ';
    combined += desc;

    // limit to 255 chars
    combined = truncate(combined, 255);

    // inject single meta tag
    upsertMeta('description', combined);

    console.log('✅ Injected unified meta description:', combined);
    return !!combined;
  }

  // --- run early & retry if React content loads later ---
  var tries = 0;
  var interval = setInterval(function() {
    if (buildMeta()) clearInterval(interval);
    else if (tries++ > 40) clearInterval(interval);
  }, 250);
})();
</script>

<script>
(function() {
  var url = window.location.href.toLowerCase();
  var path = window.location.pathname;

  var title = (document.querySelector('meta[property="og:title"]') 
      ? document.querySelector('meta[property="og:title"]').content 
      : document.title) || 'Stórkaup';

  var description = (document.querySelector('meta[name="description"]')
      ? document.querySelector('meta[name="description"]').content
      : (document.querySelector('meta[property="og:description"]')
        ? document.querySelector('meta[property="og:description"]').content
        : 'Stórkaup býður upp á mikið úrval af rekstrarvörum og matvörum.'));

  var schemaData;

  // --- Forsíða ---
  if (url === 'https://www.storkaup.is/' || url === 'https://storkaup.is/') {
    schemaData = {
      "@context": "https://schema.org",
      "@type": "WebSite",
      "name": "Stórkaup",
      "url": "https://www.storkaup.is",
      "description": "Heildverslun með rekstrarvörur, matvörur og heilbrigðisvörur fyrir fyrirtæki á Íslandi.",
      "publisher": {
        "@type": "Organization",
        "name": "Stórkaup",
        "url": "https://www.storkaup.is",
        "logo": {
          "@type": "ImageObject",
          "url": "https://www.storkaup.is/media/logo.png"
        }
      },
      "potentialAction": {
        "@type": "SearchAction",
        "target": "https://www.storkaup.is/search?q={search_term_string}",
        "query-input": "required name=search_term_string"
      }
    };
  }

  // --- Birgjasíður ---
  else if (path.indexOf('/birgjar/') === 0) {
    schemaData = {
      "@context": "https://schema.org",
      "@type": "Brand",
      "name": title.replace(' | Stórkaup', ''),
      "description": description,
      "url": url,
      "logo": {
        "@type": "ImageObject",
        "url": "https://www.storkaup.is/media/logo.png"
      },
      "brand": {
        "@type": "Organization",
        "name": "Stórkaup",
        "url": "https://www.storkaup.is"
      }
    };
  }

  // --- Ekki injecta CollectionPage úr GTM ---
  else {
    return;
  }

  var s = document.createElement('script');
  s.type = 'application/ld+json';
  s.text = JSON.stringify(schemaData);
  document.head.appendChild(s);
})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  if (!/^\/vara(\/|$)/.test(location.pathname)) return;

  function hasType(item, type) {
    if (!item || !item['@type']) return false;

    if (Array.isArray(item['@type'])) {
      return item['@type'].indexOf(type) !== -1;
    }

    return item['@type'] === type;
  }

  function isImageUrl(url) {
    if (!url || typeof url !== 'string') return false;

    var cleanUrl = url.split('?')[0].toLowerCase();

    return (
      cleanUrl.indexOf('.jpg') !== -1 ||
      cleanUrl.indexOf('.jpeg') !== -1 ||
      cleanUrl.indexOf('.png') !== -1 ||
      cleanUrl.indexOf('.webp') !== -1 ||
      cleanUrl.indexOf('.gif') !== -1
    );
  }

  function cleanProductImages(product) {
    if (!product || !product.image) return false;

    var changed = false;

    if (Array.isArray(product.image)) {
      var filtered = product.image.filter(isImageUrl);

      if (filtered.length !== product.image.length) {
        product.image = filtered;
        changed = true;
      }
    } else if (typeof product.image === 'string') {
      if (!isImageUrl(product.image)) {
        delete product.image;
        changed = true;
      }
    }

    return changed;
  }

  function removeCollectionPageAndCleanProducts() {
    var scripts = document.querySelectorAll('script[type="application/ld+json"]');

    for (var i = 0; i < scripts.length; i++) {
      try {
        var data = JSON.parse(scripts[i].textContent);
        var changed = false;

        // Standalone CollectionPage á vörusíðu → fjarlægja
        if (hasType(data, 'CollectionPage')) {
          scripts[i].remove();
          continue;
        }

        // JSON-LD array
        if (Array.isArray(data)) {
          var filteredArray = data.filter(function (item) {
            return !hasType(item, 'CollectionPage');
          });

          if (filteredArray.length !== data.length) {
            data = filteredArray;
            changed = true;
          }

          data.forEach(function (item) {
            if (hasType(item, 'Product')) {
              if (cleanProductImages(item)) changed = true;
            }
          });

          if (changed) {
            scripts[i].textContent = JSON.stringify(data);
          }

          continue;
        }

        // @graph
        if (data && Array.isArray(data['@graph'])) {
          var filteredGraph = data['@graph'].filter(function (item) {
            return !hasType(item, 'CollectionPage');
          });

          if (filteredGraph.length !== data['@graph'].length) {
            data['@graph'] = filteredGraph;
            changed = true;
          }

          data['@graph'].forEach(function (item) {
            if (hasType(item, 'Product')) {
              if (cleanProductImages(item)) changed = true;
            }
          });

          if (changed) {
            scripts[i].textContent = JSON.stringify(data);
          }

          continue;
        }

        // Standalone Product
        if (hasType(data, 'Product')) {
          if (cleanProductImages(data)) {
            scripts[i].textContent = JSON.stringify(data);
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }
  }

  var attempts = 0;
  var timer = setInterval(function () {
    removeCollectionPageAndCleanProducts();

    attempts++;

    if (attempts >= 20) {
      clearInterval(timer);
    }
  }, 250);

  removeCollectionPageAndCleanProducts();
})();
</script>

<script>
(function () {
  if (!/^\/(vara|flokkur)(\/|$)/.test(location.pathname)) return;

  var MAX_WAIT_MS = 15000;
  var startedAt = Date.now();

  function cleanText(text) {
    return (text || '')
      .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
      .replace(/\s+\|\s+/g, ' ')
      .replace(/\s+–\s+/g, ' ')
      .replace(/\s+-\s+/g, ' ')
      .trim();
  }

  function hasType(item, type) {
    if (!item || !item['@type']) return false;
    if (Array.isArray(item['@type'])) return item['@type'].indexOf(type) !== -1;
    return item['@type'] === type;
  }

  function getProductSchema() {
    var scripts = document.querySelectorAll('script[type="application/ld+json"]');

    for (var i = 0; i < scripts.length; i++) {
      try {
        var data = JSON.parse(scripts[i].textContent);

        if (hasType(data, 'Product')) return data;

        if (Array.isArray(data)) {
          for (var a = 0; a < data.length; a++) {
            if (hasType(data[a], 'Product')) return data[a];
          }
        }

        if (data && Array.isArray(data['@graph'])) {
          for (var g = 0; g < data['@graph'].length; g++) {
            if (hasType(data['@graph'][g], 'Product')) return data['@graph'][g];
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    return null;
  }

  function getBrandFromSchema(product) {
    if (!product || !product.brand) return '';
    if (typeof product.brand === 'string') return cleanText(product.brand);
    if (product.brand.name) return cleanText(product.brand.name);
    return '';
  }

  function getProductPageAltText() {
    var product = getProductSchema();

    var name = product && product.name ? cleanText(product.name) : '';
    var brand = getBrandFromSchema(product);

    if (!name) {
      var h1 = document.querySelector('h1');
      if (h1) name = cleanText(h1.textContent);
    }

    if (!brand) {
      var h1El = document.querySelector('h1');

      if (h1El && h1El.parentElement) {
        var parentText = h1El.parentElement.innerText || '';
        var lines = parentText
          .split('\n')
          .map(cleanText)
          .filter(Boolean);

        for (var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
          var line = lines[i];

          if (
            line &&
            line !== name &&
            line.length < 60 &&
            line.indexOf('Vörunúmer') === -1 &&
            line.indexOf('Verð') === -1 &&
            line.indexOf('Mitt verð') === -1 &&
            line.indexOf('Lesa meira') === -1
          ) {
            brand = line;
            break;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    if (!brand || !name) return '';

    return cleanText(brand + ' ' + name);
  }

  function isCandidateImage(img) {
    if (!img) return false;

    var src = (img.currentSrc || img.src || '').toLowerCase();
    var alt = (img.getAttribute('alt') || '').toLowerCase();
    var rect = img.getBoundingClientRect();

    if (!src) return false;
    if (src.indexOf('logo') !== -1) return false;
    if (alt.indexOf('stórkaup') !== -1) return false;
    if (rect.width < 80 || rect.height < 80) return false;

    return true;
  }

  function applyProductPageAlt() {
    var altText = getProductPageAltText();
    if (!altText) return false;

    var imgs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('img'))
      .filter(isCandidateImage);

    if (!imgs.length) return false;

    imgs.sort(function(a, b) {
      var ar = a.getBoundingClientRect();
      var br = b.getBoundingClientRect();
      return (br.width * br.height) - (ar.width * ar.height);
    });

    var mainImg = imgs[0];

    mainImg.setAttribute('alt', altText);
    mainImg.setAttribute('data-storkaup-alt-fixed', 'true');

    return true;
  }

  function getCardAltText(card) {
    if (!card) return '';

    var texts = Array.from(card.querySelectorAll('*'))
      .map(function(el) {
        return cleanText(el.textContent);
      })
      .filter(Boolean);

    var brand = '';
    var name = '';

    for (var i = 0; i < texts.length; i++) {
      var t = texts[i];

      if (
        !brand &&
        t.length <= 40 &&
        t.indexOf('Vörunúmer') === -1 &&
        t.indexOf('Verð') === -1 &&
        t.indexOf('Mitt verð') === -1 &&
        t.indexOf('Bæta') === -1 &&
        t.indexOf('Setja') === -1 &&
        !/^\d/.test(t)
      ) {
        brand = t;
        continue;
      }

      if (
        brand &&
        !name &&
        t !== brand &&
        t.length > 3 &&
        t.indexOf('Vörunúmer') === -1 &&
        t.indexOf('Verð') === -1 &&
        t.indexOf('Mitt verð') === -1 &&
        t.indexOf('Bæta') === -1 &&
        t.indexOf('Setja') === -1
      ) {
        name = t;
        break;
      }
    }

    if (!brand || !name) return '';

    return cleanText(brand + ' ' + name);
  }

  function applyCategoryAltText() {
    var applied = 0;
    var imgs = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('img'));

    imgs.forEach(function(img) {
      if (!isCandidateImage(img)) return;

      var card = img.closest('a, article, li, [class*="card"], [class*="group"], [class*="border"]');
      var altText = getCardAltText(card);

      if (!altText) return;

      img.setAttribute('alt', altText);
      img.setAttribute('data-storkaup-alt-fixed', 'true');
      applied++;
    });

    return applied > 0;
  }

  function applyAltText() {
    if (/^\/vara(\/|$)/.test(location.pathname)) {
      return applyProductPageAlt();
    }

    if (/^\/flokkur(\/|$)/.test(location.pathname)) {
      return applyCategoryAltText();
    }

    return false;
  }

  var interval = setInterval(function () {
    if (applyAltText() || Date.now() - startedAt > MAX_WAIT_MS) {
      clearInterval(interval);
      if (observer) observer.disconnect();
    }
  }, 250);

  var observer = new MutationObserver(function () {
    applyAltText();
  });

  observer.observe(document.documentElement, {
    childList: true,
    subtree: true,
    characterData: true,
    attributes: true,
    attributeFilter: ['src', 'srcset', 'alt', 'data-src']
  });

  applyAltText();
})();
</script>
